rationale: Reallocated scarce fp16 export budget around the winning recurrent tail: keep only one trailing proj block in fp16, switch recurrent-tail keepers from Q+K toward Q+V, and narrow export EMA tracking to qkv/proj/embed tensors instead of every kept float tensor. This targets the local near-miss signal that recurrent-tail value preservation matters more than broad float rescue under the final int8+zlib roundtrip metric.
title: Tail Value FP16 Reallocation
